description: This file defines the UserDemoData class used for generating demo user data within the SuiteCRM project. It contains methods for creating seed users, managing demo data, and related utility functions.

classes.name: UserDemoData
classes.description: Class responsible for creating demo user data for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the demo data creator with a seed user and scale flag.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Generates demo users based on predefined data and scale settings.

methods.name: _create_seed_user
methods.description: Creates a seed user in the system with specified attributes.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_user_list
methods.description: Returns a list of user names for demo data seeding.

methods.name: _quick_create_user
methods.description: Creates a demo user quickly if it does not already exist.

properties.name: _user
properties.description: The seed user object used as a template or reference.

properties.name: _large_scale_test
properties.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to generate a larger set of demo users.

properties.name: guids
properties.description: Associative array mapping user identifiers to GUIDs.

methods.name: _create_seed_user
methods.description: Creates a new user bean and populates it with provided data, then saves it.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_user_list
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of user names for demo purposes.

methods.name: _quick_create_user
methods.description: Creates a user swiftly if it doesn't exist, using demo data.
